scripts.stop: bun -e "const f = Bun.file('.server.pid'); if (!(await f.exists())) console.log('not running'); else { const pid = Number(await f.text()); try { if (!(pid > 0)) throw 0; process.kill(pid, 'SIGTERM'); console.log('stopped ' + pid); } catch { await f.delete(); console.log('removed stale pid file'); } }"
